DResampleCurve
create inCurve inc generic
inCurve accepts curve
inCurve storable 0
inCurve writable 1
inCurve readable 0
add inCurve
create Sampling smp int 12
Sampling min 8
Sampling max 1000000
Sampling softMax 50
Sampling keyable 1
add Sampling
create outCurve oc curve null
outCurve writable 0
outCurve storable 0
add outCurve
affects inCurve outCurve
affects Sampling outCurve
DBSCurve
create inBaseCurve inbc generic
inBaseCurve accepts curve
inBaseCurve storable 0
inBaseCurve writable 1
inBaseCurve readable 0
add inBaseCurve
create inTargetCurve intc generic
inTargetCurve accepts curve
inTargetCurve storable 0
inTargetCurve writable 1
inTargetCurve readable 0
add inTargetCurve
create Blend bld double 0
Blend softMin 0
Blend softMax 1
Blend keyable 1
add Blend
create Sampling smp int 12
Sampling min 8
Sampling max 1000000
Sampling softMax 50
Sampling keyable 1
add Sampling
create outCurve oc curve null
outCurve writable 0
outCurve storable 0
add outCurve
affects inBaseCurve outCurve
affects inTargetCurve outCurve
affects Blend outCurve
affects Sampling outCurve
